name: IntPhys
summary: 面向视觉直觉物理评测的合成数据集，通过可能与不可能的场景测试物体恒存、遮挡和支撑关系，避免模型只依赖单帧外观线索。
scale: Controlled videos across object permanence, shape and support scenarios
license: Research dataset terms; verify current download agreement
wmNote: 适合评测物体恒存和视觉合理性，但任务规模与视觉复杂度有限，主要用于诊断而非大规模预训练。
summaryEn: A synthetic visual-physics benchmark contrasting possible and impossible scenes to test object permanence, occlusion, shape, and support reasoning.
wmNoteEn: Effective for diagnosing object permanence and plausibility, but its scale and visual complexity make it primarily an evaluation resource.
scaleZh: 覆盖物体恒存、形状和支撑关系的受控视频

evidence.sourceTitle: [1803.07616] IntPhys: A Framework and Benchmark for Visual Intuitive Physics Reasoning
evidence.statement: Possible/impossible physical event videos are evaluated using future semantic-mask prediction and physical plausibility.
